name: sequeless
description: This root package is deliberately not an npm workspace because npm workspace hoisting would lift node_modules to the repo root and break the Angular CLI's resolution of its own builder plugins, which must resolve next to sequeless-ui/angular.json.

scripts.verify: npm run build:ui && npm --prefix sequeless-ui test -- --watch=false && mvn -B -ntp verify
scripts.ci:ui: npm --prefix sequeless-ui ci && npm --prefix sequeless-ui run lint && npm --prefix sequeless-ui test -- --watch=false && npm --prefix sequeless-ui run build
